title: WheezoMeter® Correlation Study
brief_summary: The primary goal of the study is to more firmly establish correlations between WheezeRate(Wz%) and other parameters used to assess wheezing and asthma including spirometry, provider's auscultation, and symptoms at the time of Wz% measurement.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients \<= 12 years of age who have wheezing at the time of study as confirmed by the physicians' auscultation.

Control:

* Patients \<= 12 years of age without history of asthma or other pulmonary conditions, and who are without wheezing on physical exam.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Medical problems that would contraindicate Wz% measurement.
